subtopics.title: Simplest Foundation Model Application Architecture
subtopics.summary: The baseline architecture for a foundation model application, consisting of a model and a user interface, serving as the starting point before adding complexity.

subtopics.title: Challenges of Simple AI Application Architectures
subtopics.summary: The limitations and failure modes encountered when using only the simplest architecture, which motivate the addition of further components.

subtopics.title: Incremental Component Addition for AI Products
subtopics.summary: The gradual approach of adding engineering components to address specific challenges and build more successful AI applications.

subtopics.title: User Feedback in AI Product Evaluation
subtopics.summary: The process of putting an application in front of users to gather feedback and determine whether it achieves its intended goals.
